$comment: Generated by tool/contracts/generate.py from tzdata 2026f — do not edit by hand. Instants are UTC; local times are a zone's wall clock. "zone": null is not stated, which is Pakistan time. Rows with "pg": true are also checked against PostgreSQL (suite 23); the others are Dart-only.
rule: a local time a clock change skips or repeats is read as the later of its two instants (PostgreSQL); quiet hours [start, end) end at the first later instant the wall clock is outside them
